# Hallmark ORA of DE genes (T1S1 DESeq2, treated vs control; 3v3 replicates).
# Design: unranked ORA, up and down separately (padj<0.05), plus all DE combined.
# Background: all genes with a non-NA padj (tested genes) -- the universe of detectable genes.
# Gene sets: MSigDB Hallmark 2024.1 symbols, filtered to 15-500 genes AFTER intersecting with background.
# Choices that read the data: padj<0.05 threshold (no LFC cutoff). BH within each direction.
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
PADJ=0.05
de=pd.read_csv("/analysis-001/runs/run-001/T1S1/work/de_results.csv")
de=de.dropna(subset=["padj","symbol"])
bg=set(de.symbol)
sets={}
for l in open("/mnt/refs/msigdb/hallmark/h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"):
    p=l.rstrip("\n").split("\t"); sets[p[0]]=set(p[2:])
sig=de[de.padj<PADJ]
groups={"up":set(sig[sig.log2FoldChange>0].symbol),"down":set(sig[sig.log2FoldChange<0].symbol),"all_DE":set(sig.symbol)}
def bh(p):
    p=np.asarray(p);n=len(p);o=np.argsort(p);r=p[o]*n/np.arange(1,n+1)
    r=np.minimum.accumulate(r[::-1])[::-1];out=np.empty(n);out[o]=np.minimum(r,1);return out
rows=[]
for g,hits in groups.items():
    hits=hits&bg;N=len(bg);n=len(hits);tmp=[]
    for t,s in sets.items():
        s=s&bg
        if not 15<=len(s)<=500: continue
        ov=hits&s;k=len(ov);K=len(s)
        tmp.append(dict(term=t,source="MSigDB_Hallmark_2024.1",direction=g,size=K,n_hits=n,overlap=k,
          fold_enrichment=(k/n)/(K/N) if n else np.nan,pvalue=hypergeom.sf(k-1,N,K,n),genes=";".join(sorted(ov))))
    d=pd.DataFrame(tmp);d["FDR"]=bh(d.pvalue);rows.append(d)
res=pd.concat(rows).sort_values(["direction","pvalue"])
res.to_csv("hallmark_ora_results.csv",index=False)
print(len(bg),{g:len(h&bg) for g,h in groups.items()})
print(res[res.FDR<0.05][["term","direction","size","overlap","fold_enrichment","FDR"]].to_string())
# dot plot: top sets per direction
top=pd.concat([res[res.direction==g].head(8) for g in ["up","down"]])
top=top[top.overlap>0]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,6))
labs=[f"{t.replace('HALLMARK_','')}" for t in top.term]
y=np.arange(len(top))[::-1]
sc=ax.scatter(top.direction.map({"up":0,"down":1}),y,s=top.overlap*25+10,c=-np.log10(top.FDR.clip(lower=1e-300)),cmap="viridis")
ax.set_yticks(y);ax.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=8);ax.set_xticks([0,1]);ax.set_xticklabels(["Up","Down"]);ax.set_xlim(-.5,1.5)
plt.colorbar(sc,label="-log10 FDR");ax.set_title("Hallmark ORA (size = overlap genes)")
plt.tight_layout();plt.savefig("hallmark_dotplot.png",dpi=150)
